description.value: Lakeside Villa is an owner-operated boutique motel tucked between Skaha and Okanagan Lakes in Penticton, featuring a private on-site Nordic Spa ('Skahä Nordic') with hot/cold therapy. Renovated suites range from studios to one-bedroom units, many with full kitchens and glimpses of Skaha Lake. The property includes private access to Barefoot Beach and explicitly provides storage for bikes, kayaks, and paddleboards — a practical stop for multi-day touring cyclists in the Okanagan.

address.value: 4201 Skaha Lake Road, Penticton, BC V2A 0K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and active, confirming the property is a real, operating motel-and-spa in Penticton. The facilities section explicitly lists 'Bike, Kayak & Paddleboard Storage', confirming secure bike storage; 'Guest Laundry' and 'Complimentary Wi-Fi' are also explicitly listed under property essentials and room amenities.
